p: Both armies on the march. Buford's Union cavalry occupies Gettysburg. Heth's Confederate division marches east on Chambersburg Pike toward Gettysburg.

By nightfall the Union Army holds the fish-hook line: Cemetery Hill, Cemetery Ridge, Culp's Hill. Meade arrives in person at ~11pm. Holds council of war — decides to stay and fight. Confederate army holds Seminary Ridge and the town.
The fish-hook defensive line the Union occupied at the end of July 1 was one of the strongest defensive positions of the war.

p.author_line: Ask the Historian site records (chronology commentary)

p: Buford's pickets on Knoxlyn Ridge first spot Heth's advance. Vedette Lieutenant Marcellus Jones fires the FIRST SHOT of the Battle of Gettysburg from a borrowed carbine. Jones fires at a Confederate officer at approximately 7:30am.

p.short: Site chronology, Day 1 (Knoxlyn Ridge west of Gettysburg)

p: Heth's skirmishers engage Buford's dismounted cavalry. Pegram's Confederate artillery deploys on Herr Ridge. First artillery fire of the battle.

p.short: Site chronology, Day 1 (Herr Ridge / McPherson's Ridge)

p: Calef's battery (Battery A, 2nd US Artillery) opens fire — FIRST UNION ARTILLERY to fire at Gettysburg. Six guns engage Pegram's battalion in counterbattery duel.
Buford sends urgent dispatch to Reynolds: Confederates advancing in force, cavalry cannot hold long. Reynolds rides ahead of I Corps to assess situation personally.

p.short: Site chronology, Day 1 (Emmitsburg Road south of Gettysburg)

p: Heth deploys Archer's brigade south of Chambersburg Pike and Davis's brigade north. Both advance in line of battle toward McPherson's Ridge. Gamble's dismounted troopers fall back slowly.

p.short: Site chronology, Day 1 (West of McPherson's Ridge)

p: Reynolds arrives at Seminary Ridge, confers with Buford in the Seminary cupola. Reynolds sends courier ordering I Corps to rush forward at the double-quick. Confirms he will hold at all costs.
Reynolds's decision to hold at Gettysburg rather than fall back sealed the battle's location.

p.author_line: Ask the Historian site records (chronology commentary)

p: Wadsworth's division (I Corps lead) arrives at Seminary Ridge at the double-quick. Reynolds personally leads the Iron Brigade (Meredith) off the road and into Herbst Woods.

p.short: Site chronology, Day 1 (Seminary Ridge to McPherson's Ridge)

p: Iron Brigade double-quicks through fields toward Herbst Woods. Confederates recognize the black hats — 'That's no militia — that's the Army of the Potomac!' Archer's brigade halts momentarily.

p.short: Site chronology, Day 1 (West of Herbst Woods)

p: REYNOLDS KILLED. Shot through the head by a sharpshooter (possibly a Confederate skirmisher) at the eastern edge of Herbst Woods while directing the Iron Brigade. Falls dead from his horse. Doubleday assumes corps command.
